posts.title: How do you use the profitability framework when a client's profits fall?
posts.description: "How can the client make more profit?" Profits are falling, or the client wants them higher.
posts.k: frameworks structuring diagnose When you will use it Ask this first The structure Make it your own The mistake to avoid Practise with real prompts 1. A national bank's mortgage applications are down 20% this year. Why? 2. A ski resort's profits fell 40% after two warm winters. 3. A cinema chain's attendance is still 25% below pre-pandemic levels.

posts.title: How do you structure a case where the client needs to cut costs?
posts.description: "How can the client cut costs?" The client needs to cut costs, often by a target percentage.
posts.k: frameworks structuring diagnose When you will use it Ask this first The structure Make it your own The mistake to avoid Practise with real prompts 1. A fashion retailer's online returns now cost $40M a year, double three years ago. 2. A retail bank wants to cut operating costs by 15% in two years. 3. A food-delivery start-up is burning $5M a month. Where would you cut?

posts.title: How do you structure a case about making a process faster or cheaper?
posts.description: "How can the client improve this process?" Operations cases: something is slow, costly or error-prone.
posts.k: frameworks structuring diagnose When you will use it Ask this first The structure Make it your own The mistake to avoid Practise with real prompts 1. A hospital's emergency waiting times have doubled in a year. 2. A parcel company's on-time delivery fell from 95% to 85%. 3. An airline's aircraft spend 20% longer on the ground between flights than rivals'.

posts.title: How should a client respond when a competitor makes a move?
posts.description: "How should the client respond to a rival's move?" A rival cuts prices, launches a product or enters the market.
posts.k: frameworks structuring decide When you will use it Ask this first The structure Make it your own The mistake to avoid Practise with real prompts 1. A rival has cut prices 20% on our best-selling product. How do we respond? 2. How should an electricity company respond to the growth of rooftop solar? 3. A shampoo brand has lost 4 points of market share in a year.
